name: RBC ION+ Visa

annual_fee.waiver_conditions: Annual fee is rebated for students or anyone 24 or younger who opens an RBC Advantage Banking Account for Students.

apr.notes: 20.99% on purchases; 22.99% on cash advances. Quebec residents may have a different purchase rate.

fx_fee.notes: RBC does not publish the foreign transaction fee on the product page; confirm the current percentage in the RBC cardholder agreement.

credit_required.notes: Canadian resident who has reached the age of majority in their province or territory.

base_rate.description: 1 Avion point per $1 on all other qualifying purchases.

categories.label: Gas and EV charging, daily transit and rideshare
Streaming, digital gaming and digital subscriptions

rewards.redemption_notes: Avion points redeem for travel, gift cards, merchandise, statement credits and transfers to partner programs.

signup_bonus.description: Up to 28,000 Avion points: 7,000 on approval, 14,000 after spending $1,500 in the first 6 months, and a 7,000 one-time anniversary bonus. Offer advertised for applications by 2026-11-04.

benefits.title: Mobile Device Insurance
benefits.description: Up to two years of coverage to a maximum of $1,000 if an eligible mobile device is lost, stolen, accidentally damaged, or suffers mechanical failure when purchased with the card.

benefits.title: Purchase Security and Extended Warranty Insurance
benefits.description: Protects eligible purchases against loss, theft, or damage within 90 days and doubles the manufacturer warranty by up to one additional year, to a maximum of five years.

benefits.title: Student Annual Fee Rebate
benefits.description: The annual fee is rebated for students or anyone 24 or younger who opens an RBC Advantage Banking Account for Students.

notes: The issuer page does not name a network package tier, so network_tier is none.
